overview: A listed guesthouse, bar and restaurant in Ballintoy village, refurbished with ten deluxe bedrooms and rooms ranging from singles to family rooms. Food is served daily, there is live music on Saturdays, and three rooms take dogs. Ballintoy Harbour and Carrick-a-Rede are within walking distance, and White Park Bay is a short drive west.
surfTripFit: Rooms, a pub and a restaurant all in one place, a few minutes from White Park Bay, with dog-friendly rooms too.
